verdicts.reason: A keeps the attribution at a readable size and the quote wraps cleanly, but the backdrop circle is pulled fully inside the canvas instead of bleeding off the corner, so it reads as a floating disc that crowds the attribution, and the can is shrunk until its label can't be read. B keeps the original's corner bleed, but 'THE GROVE TASTING TEAM' is shrunk until it can't be read, the circle rises far enough to sit under the end of the quote, and the can is pushed close to the bottom edge, so it looks cramped.
